name: screenshot-paste
title: Screenshot Paste
description: Capture the screen under your cursor and paste it where you type - no mouse needed.
author: chomamateusz

commands.name: capture-and-paste
commands.title: Paste New Screenshot: Screen Under Cursor
commands.description: Capture the display under the mouse pointer and paste it where you are typing

commands.name: capture-display-and-paste
commands.title: Paste New Screenshot: Choose Screen
commands.description: Pick a display from a list (the real screen lights up), then capture it and paste it where you are typing

preferences.name: pasteMode
preferences.title: Paste As
preferences.description: File: the clipboard holds the PNG file, like dragging it from Finder - works in Slack, Cursor, Teams, Mail, Messages. Image: the clipboard holds pixel data, like Cmd-Shift-Ctrl-4 - for apps that reject files; needs Accessibility permission for Raycast.

preferences.name: afterPaste
preferences.title: After Pasting
preferences.description: Save the pasted screenshot to the screenshot folder, or discard it

preferences.name: captureDelayMs
preferences.title: Capture Delay
preferences.description: Milliseconds to wait after closing Raycast before capturing
